The Sual Port Zone, is hereby placed under the administrative
jurisdiction of the Philippine Ports Authority, which shall, consistent with the regional
industrial plans of the Government, implement a program for the proper zoning,
planning, development and utilization of the port pursuant to Presidential Decree No.

All other orders, proclamations and issuances or portions thereof which
are inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila,
